messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning to enable the new console hidden-settings beta toggle (beta_hidden_settings_v2) for a small opt-in today. Need backend guardrails so orgs without the entitlement can't flip it. @Jonah can you confirm where to wire the entitlement check?

Jonah Kim: I can add an entitlement middleware. Quick Q — should we block the flag server-side or merely hide the UI if entitlement missing?

Samir Rao: backend enforcement is safer. If we only hide in UI we'll get weird audit gaps. Also we should emit an audit event whenever the flag evaluates true.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Proposed rollout audiences: internal staff allowlist, early-partners allowlist, then 10% random for everyone else. Default off for enterprise unless explicitly enable via entitlement. Add a rollback toggle and a kill-switch route.

Maya Patel: Example flag config I want in the repo (simple sketch):

```json
{
  "feature_flag": "beta_hidden_settings_v2",
  "enabled": false,
  "audiences": [
    {"type":"allowlist","ids":["redwood-dev","acme-partner"]},
    {"type":"percentage","value":10}
  ],
  "entitlement_required": "console_hidden_settings.access",
  "record_audit": true
}
```

Jonah Kim: Perfect. I'll put the entitlement check into the flag evaluation path (server-side) and short-circuit if missing. Branch: feature/flag/hidden-v2-guardrails. Will ping @EngOps Bot for a canary deploy.

Priya Singh: For launch comms — product wants a small in-console banner for beta participants: "You're in the beta for hidden console settings — give feedback" + link to feedback doc. Also need a short support blurb.

Samir Rao: PR up now for the middleware and audit events. CR requested from @Priya and @Maya. Tests include evaluation fallback and audit payload schema.

Maya Patel: Monitoring guardrails: set alerts if error rate for the flag evaluation path > 1% or if median eval latency > 200ms over 5m. Also track conversion telemetry (use of hidden settings).

Jonah Kim: Will add SLOs and a dashboard tile. Event schema I'm adding: event.type = "feature_flag.eval", props = {"flag":"beta_hidden_settings_v2","result":true/false,"entitlement":true/false}.

EngOps Bot: deploy started — canary groups: redwood-dev + acme-partner + 10% random for region us-west-2. Canary id: canary-2029-hiddenv2.

Priya Singh: :thumbsup: I'll draft the banner copy and the support blurb; will post in #marketing when ready.

Samir Rao: CR merged. Rolling out to 10% now. Tests green locally and in canary.

EngOps Bot: deploy finished. canary-2029-hiddenv2: enabled for 10% audience. Monitoring endpoint: https://console.monitoring/redwood/flags/canary-2029-hiddenv2

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — leave the canary for 24h, then we'll evaluate and consider increasing to 50% if metrics are stable. If anything spikes, use the kill-switch: POST /flags/kill/beta_hidden_settings_v2 (ops-only).

Jonah Kim: noted. I'll have alerts + runbook linked on the dashboard.

Samir Rao: FYI added a unit test for entitlement false -> flag eval false. Good to go.

Priya Singh: I'll follow up with copy and a short FAQ in #product-docs.

Maya Patel: Cool. Closing async sync — ping in thread if you see anything odd. :rocket:
